scope: Prevent prepare on inactive SKU; durably reject a newly observed SKU_INACTIVE at the explicit pre-mapping branch. Existing success writer/readback/ACL remains authoritative. This is not a generic negative-receipt implementation for every 4xx or legacy incident.

prepare.body: Existing owner body; warehouse_id optional but must match confirmed context. Do not submit actor/session or invented recovery fields.
prepare.inactive: 422 SKU_INACTIVE; no hold acquired/extended and no hardware write allowed.

recovery_headers.X-NFC-Recovery-Key: Idempotency-Key of the proven rejected confirm, not its HTTP trace UUID

prepare.recovery: Explicit user confirmation only after GET reports may_create_new_request=true. Rechecks active account/session/warehouse/SKU, item status, pending operations, no conflicting current tag and ownership of any remaining hold. Releases only matching rejected hold; replaces it with a fresh reservation. Never deletes a mapping or erases a physical chip.
prepare.repeat: Before dispatch of confirm, repeated recovery prepare can resume the same live recovery reservation. Expiry/lost cache or an already-bound confirm does NOT grant another prepare permit.

confirm.same_key: Same canonical request replays the immutable rejection even after SKU activation; changed identity/body conflicts. No shared IdempotencyStore behavior is changed for other modules.
confirm.new_attempt: Requires explicit recovery prepare, a DIFFERENT physically verified blank chip/UID, a fresh confirm key and the new reservation. Old token and rejected UID are permanently fenced. The new confirm identity is durably bound before calling the writer; unexpected error/ambiguous commit keeps it blocked pending reconciliation, never automatic takeover.
confirm.physical_note: Server cannot verify actual blank silicon or undo NDEF. Operator/approved device bridge must isolate old written chip and verify a new blank chip; CI is not hardware acceptance.

confirmation.query: warehouse_id optional, must match context; never search by display serial or HTTP trace instead of item/key.
confirmation.legacy_client: Without X-NFC-Recovery-Contract an existing rejection remains UNKNOWN / may_create_new_request=false and exposes recovery_contract_required. Existing success/processing/unknown schemas are unchanged.
confirmation.rejected: HTTP 200; data.state=REJECTED, data.http_status=422, data.response is original rejected response, data.receipt is immutable proof; data.recovery describes CURRENT eligibility. GET is read-only and never releases a reservation.
confirmation.permission_to_begin: data.may_create_new_request=true permits only the explicit recovery PREPARE step, NOT blind PATCH/retry. Once prepare permit consumed it is false even while that prepared flow may continue. Check data.recovery.prepare_allowed/permit_consumed/confirm_dispatched/completed.
confirmation.unknown: No rejection row means no inferred failure: delegate to the existing confirmation. null/404/current mapping/expiry/health/ACTIVE SKU are not terminal proof.
confirmation.trace: original_request_id is HTTP trace UUID or null. request_key_sha256 is SHA256 of trimmed original Idempotency-Key. Neither is a scan session ID.

retention_and_sessions.retention: No automatic pruning or deletion of rejection/key/token/UID fences. Administrative data-retention policy must preserve dedup safety before any future cleanup.
retention_and_sessions.refresh: Same stable auth_session_id continues to read and recover under current ACL.
retention_and_sessions.new_login: No rebind: old actor/key with new auth_session_id returns NFC_CONFIRMATION_CONTEXT_MISMATCH. No password/token stored in checkpoints or rejection journal.
retention_and_sessions.legacy_incident: Pre-deployment failures with no durable receipt remain UNKNOWN. Source/HTTP422 alone cannot backfill proof. DEV must correlate exact deployed build, original key and full canonical request, actor/session/warehouse/item/UID, audit, idempotency row, all in-flight attempts and transaction outcome. This change does NOT authorize reuploading/reconfirming that old incident and does not synthesize its historical receipt.
retention_and_sessions.legacy_resolution_gate: When legacy failure is independently established, owner/DB operator must provide an explicitly approved fenced migration/recovery action for that exact operation before a new physical attempt. Do not direct-edit success, delete idempotency/mapping rows, flush Redis, auto release or reuse old chip to bypass UNKNOWN.

errors.note: Keep existing auth, SKU/item, UID/payload, reservation and validation errors. Malformed/proxy responses and 5xx are not definitive rejection receipts.

acceptance.test: tests/Feature/P07NfcRecoveryTest.php plus unchanged P07/P15/P17/auth regressions; disposable SQLite/PostgreSQL only
acceptance.live: Verify released build ancestry, required schema, route-cache rebuild, permissions, timeout/replay, reservations and approved real hardware readback. No seed, live mutation, cache flush or .env bypass performed by this handoff.
